'''Yoshino Ohtori''' (Japanese: '''鳳芳野''' ''Ōtori Yoshino'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Ohtori was born on March 19, 1947, in {{wp|Yokohama, Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She has been voice acting since 1976 and started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|SM}}, where she voiced {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Naganadel}}. She is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
